scope: Changed feedback and notification write rules only; not a whole-database assessment
summary: The changed write paths enforce signed coach identity, current profile and class assignment, student target, author ownership, restricted fields, and bounded typed content. Emulator checks cover forged authors, cross-class requests, update bypasses, notification tampering, reassignment and suspension.
limitations: Other collection rules and existing read policies were not comprehensively audited by this change.
Production rules must be deployed and verified separately.
Existing invalid legacy feedback documents are readable according to existing read policy but cannot be updated without satisfying the new schema.
